name: Colin
source:
Danielle's spoiled little brother, he and his sister get along great, but the older guys find him abrasive.

Colin just lives to entertain himself, but unlike his sister, his smug self-amusement is more solo act than life of the party. He's book-smart, street-smart, frighteningly brilliant, but not at all interested in tapering his wit or prideful attitude for the plebes whose company he keeps. He reacts to most situations with humor, like Randy, but unlike Randy, he takes himself and his abilities very seriously. Just under his noxious hyper-competency lies a deep well of insecurity: about his height, his looks, his voice, his age, and his desire to fit in and be loved by others as much as he loves himself.
